question: Queue item 20261030-1250-research-data-apis-35cd-u07-q01: yes, the card-free demo access of Mapbox warrants its own record, data-apis/mapbox-demo-access, related to data-apis/mapbox as variant_of. A discover unit can add it now: the integrator treats a draft whose tier differs from the tier of an existing record of the same provider (pay-as-you-go free tiers (payment method on file)) as another offer, so the duplicate refusal no longer applies to a draft with a tier of its own, such as demo access (no payment method), identity_cost.kind email; the draft is then related variant_of data-apis/mapbox.
why: The two tiers differ in what a reader acts on: identity (an email against a payment method on file), quota (10,000 Temporary Geocoding requests a month, a batch counting one per query, against 100,000, and no Raster Tiles API or Permanent Geocoding), rate limits (lower than the standard 1000 requests per minute, number unpublished) and failure (reaching any usage cap cuts off every Mapbox API until a payment method is added; one token that cannot be created, rotated or deleted). The sign-up guide mentions the end of the trial while the demo-access guide says the limits reset monthly, so the draft should settle whether demo access has an end date. Precedent: ci-cd-runners/github-actions-private is variant_of ci-cd-runners/github-actions-public, two records.
